t: The Erbauer Connecx tool storage system delivers comprehensive site organisation with three modular pieces including a mobile cart, organiser and toolbox. Constructed from durable high-impact resin with heavy-duty wheels, this 50kg capacity system rolls effortlessly between locations whilst keeping tools secure. The integrated water-repellent seal protects contents against dust and moisture, whilst lockable metal clamps safeguard valuable equipment on site. Fully compatible with the Connecx stacking system.
b: Hinged Lid With Lockable Metal Clamps
